title: Who Implesta is for
description: Implesta is built for firms of 20 to 150 people that sell their people's time: technical secondment, IT services and engineering consultancies.
primaryQuery: software for firms that sell billable hours
h1: For firms that sell their people's time
lead: Implesta fits firms of {firmSize} where a client request passes through several hands before it is paid: sold by one person, scoped by another, delivered by a team, invoiced by finance.

common.h2: What these firms have in common

items.title: Work moves between teams
items.text: Sales, operations and finance each have their own tool, and what one knows the others find out late.

items.title: People are the capacity
items.text: Who is free, with which skills, from when, decides what you can sell.

items.title: Hours become money
items.text: Margin depends on hours logged, approved and invoiced on time, at the rate that was sold.

final.text: {minutes} minutes with {founder}, using a scenario like yours.
